prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration. Tactile ceramic, cut paper, glass and porous limestone; ivory #F7F6F2, cobalt #1547BB, vermilion #EF383E. Gallery-quality studio lighting, material grain, clear composition and realistic shadows. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, flags, watermarks or identifiable people. Conceptual illustration, not documentary evidence or a real chart. Wide cover 1200:630. A freestanding sculptural ivory thermometer with an unnumbered recessed red fluid column stands against a cobalt wall. An anonymous ceramic hand enters from the side and covers only the middle of its blank scale. No face or realistic skin, no numerical reading; clear metaphor about hiding measurement, no accusation against an identifiable person.
